title: Hive Commons benchmark result
description: One benchmark record: a single unit of agent work (usually one pull request) with its outcome, cost and quality signals. Field names follow the hive evidence bundle (pkg/evidence.Bundle) and GET /api/cost so a spoke can emit records directly.

id.description: Stable unique id. Convention: sha256 of (hive_id, repo, pr number, head sha) hex-encoded, or any URN.

synthetic.description: True for hand-written sample records. The site excludes these from every leaderboard.

hive_id.description: Salted hash of the spoke id unless the owner opted to be named.

hive_name.description: Only present when the owner opted in (benchmarks.publish_name).

cluster.description: Free-form cluster / environment label (e.g. kind, openshift, bare-metal).

exporter.description: What produced the record, e.g. hive/api/benchmarks/export, hub/aggregate, manual.

name.description: Agent name as configured in hive.yaml (evidence author.agent).

harness.description: CLI harness / backend (evidence author.backend, crux IsCLIBackend list).

provider.description: Vendor family (pkg/modelfamily), e.g. anthropic, openai, google, ibm, local.

name.description: Exact model id as reported by the harness (evidence author.model).

effort.description: Reasoning effort / thinking budget label if the harness exposes one.

sandbox_runtime.description: Where the agent process ran (crux/config SandboxRuntime*). Open enum.

repo.description: owner/name. MUST be omitted unless repo_consent is true.

repo_consent.description: Repository owner consented to being named in published results.

language.description: Primary language of the touched files.

acmm_level.description: Policy ACMM level the hive ran at (evidence policy.acmm_level).

ci_green_first_try.description: CI status was success on the first head (evidence ci.status on the bundle with no previous_bundle_id). null = no CI captured.

review_verdict.description: Worst swarm verdict on the final head (evidence verdicts[].verdict).

reviewer_models.description: Exact model ids of the reviewing perspectives.

wall_clock_s.description: merge.at - merge.opened_at, or close time for unmerged.

retries.description: Number of additional heads pushed (bundles chained by previous_bundle_id).

basis.description: How usd was computed (GET /api/cost: estimated from public price table, or apportioned from per-agent totals).

acmm_level.description: Repo overall ACMM level at the time (GET /api/acmm/evaluation overall_level); context, not an agent score.

acmm_scores.description: Per-level detected_score 0..1 keyed by level number, from GET /api/acmm/evaluation levels[].

notes.description: Free text. MUST NOT contain prompts, logins, or code excerpts.
